cands.name: Nik Dean
cands.bio: Democrat, 31. Civil defense attorney (medical malpractice) at Hall, Schieffelin & Smith; Tufts and University of Miami Law graduate. Replaced Michelle DeJesus on the ballot after she withdrew.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Maitland with his wife and young son; has lived in Central Florida for 20+ years (campaign site).

record.text: Chosen by Seminole County Democratic leaders in Aug 2026 to replace Michelle DeJesus as the nominee.

endorsements.text: Michelle DeJesus, the withdrawn nominee, endorsed him.

cands.name: Emily Duda Buckley
cands.bio: Republican, 34. External affairs at A. Duda & Sons (land management); former House Appropriations staff and Legislative Affairs Director at the Dept. of Agriculture; foster parent and Guardian ad Litem. Won the Aug. primary with about 57%.
cands.local_ties: Fifth-generation Floridian born and raised in Central Florida; Oviedo Republican (campaign site; Florida Politics).

record.text: Beat Marcus Hyatt in the Republican primary with nearly 57% after raising $205,000.
